description_en: Queries the details of slow query logs
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-slow-log-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp1z58t881wcx0000 --start-time 2022-05-20_16:00:00 --end-time 2022-05-27_16:00:00 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --query-duration-ms 1000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The format is \`yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss\`. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The format is \`yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss\`. The time is in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 7 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）。
查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且与查询开始时间间隔小于7天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (Default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The minimum query duration, in milliseconds. The minimum value is 1000. The default value is 1000. The response returns information about queries that take longer than the specified duration
parameters.help_zh: 最短的查询耗时。最小值为1000，默认值为1000。单位：毫秒。返回参数将返回超过该耗时的查询
parameters.name: query_duration_ms

QueryStartTime.description_zh: 查询开始的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）

ReadRows.description_zh: 执行语句所读取的行数
